title: unified-rollouts: enhanced canary/AB/shadow autorollback workflow & observability
author: Ethan Park
description:
Motivation: Improve safety and observability of automated rollbacks for canary, A/B and shadow rollouts. Production incidents showed gaps where transient metric spikes and out-of-band errors caused noisy rollbacks or failed to quarantine bad variants. This PR introduces a composite-metric quorum, a quarantine probing stage, improved telemetry (per-variant traces and SLO-aligned metrics), and e2e stability guards to reduce false positives and improve root-cause triage.

What this PR does: 1) Adds a composite-metric evaluator that supports weighted metrics (latency p99, error-rate, and custom regressions) and a quorum requirement across metrics before triggering an autorollback. 2) Introduces a "quarantine" intermediate stage that pauses automatic traffic shifts and runs probing requests against the candidate variant to gather preflight signals. 3) Enhances shadow traffic lifecycle: shadow requests are now sampled and traced with variant tags; failures increment a variant-specific degradation score without immediately impacting live traffic. 4) Observability: new rollout telemetry endpoints emit per-variant counters (quarantine_hits, probe_failures, metric_quorum_results) and tracing spans for rollout decision paths; dashboards and alerts added. 5) Workflows: rollback engine refactor to support staged decisions (preflight => quarantine => rollback) and deterministic replay for debugging. 6) Tests and CI: adds unit tests for composite metrics, integration tests simulating noisy metrics, and three e2e scenarios for canary/AB/shadow.

Files changed: rollout controller, autorollback engine, telemetry exporter, e2e test harness, and docs updates.

Backward compatibility and rollout plan: All changes are opt-in behind rollout.flags.autorollback_v2. Existing rollouts continue on the legacy path. We will enable the feature for internal staging first, run a 48h smoke on low-traffic tenants, then progressively enable on Dedicated pools. Rollback policy remains configurable; defaults are conservative (quorum=2/3, probe timeout=2s, probe sample rate=1%).

Checklist: 
- [x] Composite metric evaluator implementation
- [x] Quarantine probing stage and controller integration
- [x] Telemetry + dashboard snapshots
- [x] Unit + integration tests
- [x] e2e stability scenarios
- [x] Docs + migration notes

Why this is safe: Feature gated, conservative defaults, and added observability reduces blind-rollbacks. e2e scenarios reproduce historical incident patterns and ensure stability guards fire before a full rollback.

Related: ENG-3245, ENG-3289 (design doc), SUP-4321 (customer report leading to quarantine design).

refactor(rollback): decouple decision engine for deterministic replay

review_comments: Maya Thompson: Nice design. Two asks: (1) can we add a debug endpoint to fetch the current composite score breakdown for a rollout? (2) make sure probe timeouts are configurable per-variant.
Author (Ethan Park): Added /debug/rollout/{id}/score and made probe timeouts variant-configurable; pushed a follow-up commit.
Ravi Patel: Observability changes look good. Suggest we add histogram buckets for probe latencies to help distinguish flakey infra vs model regressions.
Author (Ethan Park): Added probe latency histogram and updated dashboard snapshot.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash+merge by Maya Thompson. Commit message: 'unified-rollouts: enhanced autorollback workflow (composite metrics, quarantine probes, observability)'.
release_notes:
- Introduces autorollback_v2 (opt-in).
- Composite-metric quorum to reduce false positive rollbacks.
- Quarantine probing stage for preflight validation of candidate variants.
- Enhanced rollout telemetry and tracing for per-variant debugging.
- New e2e tests and stability guards.
notes: This PR was tested in staging with a blue-green simulation and a subset of Dedicated pools. We recommend enabling rollout.flags.autorollback_v2 for canary rollouts in staging for 48h before wider rollout. Operational playbook updated in docs/rollouts/autorollback_v2.md.
